evidence_quality_notes: GEN-007 validates public Boxercraft collection feeds and public Boost search/autocomplete APIs, not authenticated wholesale, inventory, or account-specific evidence.
All public collections were enumerated from /collections.json; global catalog and empty collections are recorded but excluded from the 60-node core parity denominator.
Autocomplete parity is suggestion coverage, not full recall, because the Boost suggestion API returns a smaller product payload than full search.
The Blankets node mismatch is confirmed: browse returned 2 products, while search and autocomplete for blankets reported 3 products including Lambert Soccer Everest Blanket.
GEN-007 evidence should be revalidated before external delivery because public collection membership, search indexing, and autocomplete suggestions can change.
next_recommended_action: Commit and push the GEN-007 parity evaluator, evidence, report update, and MDE records to GitHub, then decide whether to add the parity page to the presentation deck.
